appName: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
displayName: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
display_name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
display_long_description:
An immersive VR rally racing & car racing simulation experience designed for first-person gameplay. With an intuitive VR car controller, it delivers natural steering, responsive handling, high-speed adrenaline, & terrain-based handling across detailed offroad car racing environments. Use boost on straights to maintain speed and fast-paced VR racing through technical rally routes.

Game Modes

The game features single-player & competitive racing modes. Practice rally driving across diverse tracks & environments. In competitive mode, race against a Ghost AI opponent for dynamic VR racing.

Realistic Physics & Driving Simulation

A physics-based system delivers realistic vehicle behavior on dirt, gravel, and rugged terrain. Suspension, traction, steering, & handling respond to surface conditions for better control & realism.

A detailed cockpit, stylish steering wheel, & digital speedometer enhance first-person immersion.

Environments & Dynamic Conditions

Drive through forest, mountain, canyon, & off-road environments with curves, straights, elevation changes, & technical sections. Day–night cycles & dynamic weather add variety.

Cars & Customization

Choose from customizable rally cars with unique handling, performance, & visual design. Personalize vehicles with textures, skins, & visual upgrades for different tracks.

Start your engine & experience immersive VR racing, realistic car control, customizable cars, & high-speed adrenaline filled rally driving built for VR.
